DitherSkeleton.shape: block is a rectangle you size yourself. text draws lines and circle an avatar.
DitherSkeleton.lines: How many lines for text. The last one is shorter.
DitherSkeleton.fill: Texture at rest: a dither ramp from the left, a dot lattice, diagonals or a flat tint.
DitherSkeleton.animation: sweep runs a dense band across, pulse steps the dither up and down, none holds still.
DitherSkeleton.duration: Seconds for one sweep or pulse, including the pause after it.
DitherSkeleton.delay: Seconds to wait before the first sweep.
DitherSkeleton.animated: When false it holds a still frame.
